LINHA.FILTRO: CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND ROWNUM = 1 AND CAB.AD_STATUSOL = 'I' AND CAB.AD_NUINTEGRACAO = 3
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT '1' AS REG, CAB.AD_SIGLAOL AS SIGLAOL, PAR.CGC_CPF AS PARCGC, CAB.AD_NROPEDOL AS NROPEDIQVIA, EMP.CGC AS EMPCGC, CAB.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON CEMP.CODEMP=CAB.CODEMP JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON EMP.CODEMP = CEMP.CODEMP
SELECT '2' AS REG, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DDMMYYYY') AS DTGERRETORNO, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HHMISS') AS HRGERRETORNO FROM DUAL

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT PRO.REFERENCIA, CAB.NUNOTA, TO_CHAR(ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AS QTDNEG, TO_CHAR(ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AS QTDCORTE, CASE WHEN ITE.AD_MOTIVORECUSAIQVIA IS NOT NULL THEN ITE.AD_MOTIVORECUSAIQVIA WHEN ITE.QTDNEG > (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AND (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) > 0 THEN '07' WHEN ITE.QTDNEG > (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AND (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) = 0 THEN '06' ELSE '00' END AS MOTIVORECUSA, CASE (CASE WHEN ITE.QTDNEG > (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AND (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) > 0 THEN '07' WHEN ITE.QTDNEG > (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) AND (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) = 0 THEN '06' ELSE '00' END) WHEN '07' THEN '2' WHEN '06' THEN '3' ELSE '1' END AS STATUSITEM FROM TGFITE ITE JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON CEMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP JOIN TGFEST EST ON ITE.CODPROD = EST.CODPROD AND ITE.CODEMP = EST.CODEMP UNION SELECT REC.REFERENCIA, CAB.NUNOTA, '0' AS QTDNEG, TO_CHAR(REC.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, '05' AS MOTIVORECUSA, '3' AS STATUSITEM FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN AD_PRORECINT REC ON (REC.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) )

SELECT REPLACE(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG) - SUM(ITE.QTDCONFERIDA),'.','') AS SOMAUNIDATEND, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(SUM(ITE.QTDCONFERIDA) + NVL(REC.QTDRECUSADA, 0)),'.','') AS SOMAUNIDCORTE, REPLACE(TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) + NVL(REC.QTDEANS, 0)),'.','') AS SOMAUNIDTOT FROM TGFITE ITE JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON CEMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUM(QTDNEG) AS QTDRECUSADA, COUNT(*) AS QTDEANS, NUNOTA FROM AD_PRORECINT GROUP BY NUNOTA ) REC ON REC.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA

LINHA.FILTRO: CAB.STATUSNFE IN ('A','S','R') AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND (CAB.AD_NROPEDOL IS NOT NULL AND CAB.AD_NUINTEGRACAO = 3) AND CAB.AD_STATUSOL IN('A','P','I') AND ROWNUM =1
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT '1' AS REG, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DDMMYYYY') AS DTGERNOTA, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HHMISS') AS HRGERNOTA, EMP.CGC AS EMPCGC, CAB.AD_NROPEDOL AS NROPEDIQVIA, CAB.AD_NROPEDCOMPRADOR AS NROPEDCOMPRADOR, CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.AD_SIGLAOL AS SIGLAOL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON (CEMP.CODEMP=CAB.CODEMP) INNER JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON (EMP.CODEMP = CEMP.CODEMP)

SELECT TO_CHAR(CAB.DTFATUR,'DDMMYYYY') as DTFATUR, TO_CHAR(CAB.DTFATUR,'HHMISS') AS HDFATUR, TO_CHAR(CAB.DTENTSAI,'DDMMYYYY') AS DTEMISS, PAR.CGC_CPF AS PARCGC, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.SERIENOTA, MAX(ITE.CODCFO) AS CODCFO, CAB.CHAVENFE FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC)
LINHA.COMGROUPBY: TO_CHAR(CAB.DTFATUR,'DDMMYYYY'), TO_CHAR(CAB.DTFATUR,'HHMISS'), TO_CHAR(CAB.DTENTSAI,'DDMMYYYY'), PAR.CGC_CPF, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.SERIENOTA, CAB.CHAVENFE

LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRFRETE, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRFRETE, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRSEG, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRSEG, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLROUTROS, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLROUTROS, TO_CHAR(NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV IN ('O', 'C', 'E') THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE (CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT INTEIRO FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'TIPTABPRECOS'), 0) <> 9 THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED WHEN NVL((SELECT LOGICO FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'ADIMPVLRTOTLIQ'), 'S') <> 'S' THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ) + ITE.VLRSUBST + ((CASE WHEN ITE.VLRIPI > 0 AND NVL((SELECT SOMARIPI FROM TGFTOP TP WHERE TP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER), 'N' ) <> 'N' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END ) ) END ) END ), 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRTOT, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRNOTA, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRNOTA, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRIPI, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRIPI FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA)

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.BASEICMS, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS BASEICMS, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRICMS, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRICMS, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.BASESUBSTIT, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS BASESUBSTIT, TO_CHAR(NVL(CAB.VLRSUBST, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRSUBST FROM TGFCAB CAB

SELECT PRO.REFERENCIA, PRO.CODPROD, TO_CHAR(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, ITE.CODVOL, TO_CHAR(ITP.VLRUNIT, 'FM999999V90') AS PRECOBASE, TO_CHAR(NVL(ITE.VLRDESC, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRDESC, TO_CHAR(ROUND((CASE WHEN ITE.VLRDESC = 0 OR ITE.VLRUNIT = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ITE.VLRDESC * 100) / ITE.VLRUNIT END), 2), 'FM999999V90') AS PERCDESC, TO_CHAR(NVL(ITE.VLRREPRED, 0), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRREPRED, TO_CHAR(ROUND((CASE WHEN ITE.VLRREPRED = 0 OR ITE.VLRUNIT = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (ITE.VLRREPRED * 100) / (ITE.VLRUNIT * ITE.QTDNEG) END), 2), 'FM999999V90') AS PERCREPRED, TO_CHAR((CASE WHEN ITE.QTDNEG = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CASE WHEN NVL((SELECT INTEIRO FROM TSIPAR WHERE CHAVE = 'TIPTABPRECO'),0) <> 9 THEN ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC - ITE.VLRREPRED) + ITE.VLRSUBST + ((CASE WHEN ITE.VLRIPI > 0 AND NVL((SELECT SOMARIPI FROM TGFTOP TP WHERE TP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER),'N') <> 'N' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END)) END) / ITE.QTDNEG END), 'FM999999V90') AS VLRUNIT FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA) INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON (PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD) INNER JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON (CAB.CODEMP = CEMP.CODEMP) INNER JOIN TGFVAR MOV ON (CAB.NUNOTA = MOV.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = MOV.SEQUENCIA) LEFT JOIN TGFVAR MOV2 ON (MOV.NUNOTAORIG = MOV2.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = MOV2.SEQUENCIA) LEFT JOIN TGFVAR MOV3 ON (MOV2.NUNOTAORIG = MOV3.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = MOV3.SEQUENCIA) LEFT JOIN TGFVAR MOV4 ON (MOV3.NUNOTAORIG = MOV4.NUNOTA AND ITE.SEQUENCIA = MOV4.SEQUENCIA) INNER JOIN TGFCAB PED ON (NVL(NVL(NVL(MOV4.NUNOTAORIG, MOV3.NUNOTAORIG), MOV2.NUNOTAORIG), MOV.NUNOTAORIG) = PED.NUNOTA) INNER JOIN TGFITE ITP ON (ITP.NUNOTA = PED.NUNOTA AND NVL(NVL(NVL(MOV4.SEQUENCIAORIG, MOV3.SEQUENCIAORIG), MOV2.SEQUENCIAORIG), MOV.SEQUENCIAORIG) = ITP.SEQUENCIA)
SELECT '6' AS REG, REPLACE( TO_CHAR( COUNT(DISTINCT PRO.REFERENCIA) ), '.','') AS TOTAL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON (CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA) JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD

LINHA.FILTRO: CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = 947 AND CAB.STATUSNFE IN( 'A','S') AND ISNULL(CAB.AD_STATUSOL,'') IN ('NFeEnviada', 'Concluido') AND CAB.NUNOTA = [NUNOTA]
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT '01' AS REG, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),103),'/','') AS DTTITULO, REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR, GETDATE(), 108),':','') AS HRTITULO, EMP.CGC, PAR.CGC_CPF AS CNPJ_PARCEIRO, CAB.AD_NROPEDPHARMA, CAB.AD_NROPEDCOMPRADOR, CAB.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON EMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC
SELECT PRO.REFERENCIA , ITE.QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
SELECT COUNT(1) AS QTDLINHAS , SUM(QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG FROM TGFITE ITE

LINHA.FILTRO: CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = 947 AND CAB.STATUSNFE IN( 'A','S') AND ISNULL(CAB.AD_STATUSOL,'') = 'NFeEnviada'
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT '1' AS REG , EMP.CGC , REPLACE(REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR, GETDATE(), 112),'/','') + '00000000',' ','') AS DTGERACAO , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,GETDATE(),103),'/','') AS DTTITULO , REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR, GETDATE(), 108),':','') AS HRTITULO , CAB.AD_NROPEDPHARMA , CAB.AD_NROPEDCOMPRADOR , CAB.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON EMP.CODEMP = CAB.CODEMP

SELECT PAR.CGC_CPF , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,DTENTSAI,103),'/','') AS DTENTSAI , REPLACE(CONVERT(CHAR, GETDATE(), 108),':','') AS HRTITULO , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,DTFATUR,103),'/','') AS DTFATUR , CAB.NUMNOTA , CAB.SERIENOTA , REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR,(SELECT MAX(DTVENC) FROM TGFFIN F WHERE F.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA),103),'/','') AS DTVENC , (SELECT TOP 1 ITE.CODCFO FROM TGFITE ITE WHERE ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA) AS CFOP , CAB.CHAVENFE , CAB.NUNOTA FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC
SELECT CAB.VLRFRETE , CAB.VLRSEG , SUM(VLRTOT - VLRDESC) AS TOTPRODUTOS , CAB.VLRNOTA , CAB.VLRIPI FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
SELECT CAB.BASEICMS ,CAB.VLRICMS ,CAB.BASESUBSTIT ,CAB.VLRSUBST FROM TGFCAB CAB

SELECT PRO.REFERENCIA , PRO.CODPROD , ITE.QTDNEG , ITE.CODVOL , IT.VLRUNIT AS PRECO , IT.PERCDESC , IT.VLRDESC , (ITE.VLRTOT - ITE.VLRDESC)/ITE.QTDNEG AS VLRUNIT , CASE WHEN (BH_BIOMENORUNID = ITE.CODVOL) THEN ITE.QTDNEG ELSE (CASE WHEN VOA.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA = 'D' THEN ITE.QTDNEG * QUANTIDADE ELSE ITE.QTDNEG / QUANTIDADE END) END AS FRACIONAMENTO FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFVAR VR ON VR.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND VR.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA INNER JOIN TGFITE IT ON IT.NUNOTA = VR.NUNOTAORIG AND IT.SEQUENCIA = VR.SEQUENCIAORIG LEFT JOIN TGFVOA VOA ON VOA.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND VOA.CODVOL = PRO.BH_BIOMENORUNID
SELECT COUNT(1) AS QTDLINHAS FROM TGFITE ITE
SELECT PAR.NOMEPARC , PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL , PAR.EMAIL FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC

SELECT REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PAR.CEP,'.',''),'-',''),' ','') AS CEP , UFS.UF , CID.NOMECID FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSICID CID ON CID.CODCID = PAR.CODCID INNER JOIN TSIUFS UFS ON UFS.CODUF = CID.UF

SELECT SUBSTRING(ED.TIPO,1,10) AS TIPO , ED.NOMEEND , BAI.NOMEBAI , SUBSTRING(PAR.NUMEND,1,5) AS NUMEND FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC INNER JOIN TSIEND ED ON ED.CODEND = PAR.CODEND INNER JOIN TSIBAI BAI ON BAI.CODBAI = PAR.CODBAI

LINHA.FILTRO: CAN.STATUSINTEGRACAO = 'P' AND (CAN.NROPEDOL IS NOT NULL AND CAN.NUINTEGRACAO = 3) AND ROWNUM = 1
LINHA.COMSELECT: SELECT '1' AS REG, CAN.SIGLAOL AS SIGLAOL, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'DDMMYYYY') AS DTGERNOTA, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HHMISS') AS HRGERNOTA, PAR.CGC_CPF AS PARCGC, EMP.CGC AS EMPCGC, CAN.NROPEDOL AS NROPEDIQVIA, TO_CHAR(6) AS NUCANCEL, CAN.NUNOTA FROM AD_TGFCAN CAN INNER JOIN TGFEMP CEMP ON (CEMP.CODEMP=CAN.CODEMP) INNER JOIN TSIEMP EMP ON (EMP.CODEMP = CEMP.CODEMP) INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON (PAR.CODPARC = CAN.CODPARC) INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON (TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAN.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAN.DHTIPOPER)

SELECT '2' AS REG, PRO.REFERENCIA, TO_CHAR(ITE.QTDNEG) AS QTDNEG, TO_CHAR(NVL(MOT.NUCANCEL, 6)) AS NUCANCEL FROM AD_TGFCAN CAN JOIN AD_TGFITECAN ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA=CAN.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD=ITE.CODPROD LEFT JOIN AD_MOTCAN MOT ON (CASE WHEN ITE.NUCANCEL IS NOT NULL THEN ITE.NUCANCEL ELSE CAN.NUCANCEL END) = MOT.NUCANCEL AND (CASE WHEN ITE.NUPLATAFORMA IS NOT NULL THEN ITE.NUPLATAFORMA ELSE CAN.NUPLATAFORMA END) = MOT.NUPLATAFORMA

SELECT '3' AS REG, TO_CHAR(SUM(ITE.QTDNEG), 'FM999999') AS QTDNEGTOT, REPLACE( TO_CHAR( COUNT(DISTINCT PRO.REFERENCIA) ), '.','') AS TOTAL FROM AD_TGFITECAN ITE INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON PRO.CODPROD = ITE.CODPROD
